posts.text:
Good Saturday morning from Thailand, friends! 🇹🇭🌄

I want to share a nighttime video of me treating the plants and explain why spider mites are called spider mites 🕷️🔁🌱

 The thing is, in the early stages, these tiny pests are almost impossible to spot unless you look very closely👀.The first visible signs are usually tiny white dots appearing on the leaves...

 The mites themselves tend to hide on the undersides of the leaves, making them quite difficult to detect without a microscope🔬

 But if you let the problem get out of hand, they start behaving like actual spiders and spinning webs😅  That's exactly the kind of webbing you can see in this video.

 I'll write a separate post later about how to deal with this particular pest in Asia🤫

But, in a nutshell, there are organic treatments that cause diseases in these mites, eventually killing them☠️

 This isn't my first time dealing with spider mites, so it's not a critical problem for me.

And by the way, not every cannabis strain is equally susceptible to these pests.

Have you ever had to deal with spider mites? 💚🫂
